title: The explicit scalar-forgetting map of raw derived Hom
statement: For Λ,k:W→S,G,q∈N,U and A∈Over(W), construct an additive map from the module raw derived Hom group to the abelian raw derived Hom group with coefficient A^*forget(G). Precompose the derived forgotten class by the pulled-back free represented generator map and the canonical inverse-image scalar comparison; postcompose by the shift and single comparisons and the inverse coefficient comparison. All data are constructed explicitly.

def rawModuleAbelianHomMap
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ)
    (U : S.Etale) (A : Over W) :
    (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op A) ⟶
      (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf (A.hom ≫ k) q
        (restrictedOverCoefficient
          ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
          A)).obj (op U)
